title: Syrian Flour Pilaf
description: A comforting, sugar-free-friendly dish featuring all-purpose flour and a hint of pepperiness. This warm, gooey pilaf is perfect for a cold day.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it's translucent and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Gradually add the flour, stirring constantly, until it forms a smooth paste.
Add the water and stir until the mixture is smooth and free of lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the ground black pepper and salt (if using).
Cook for another 5 minutes, or until the pilaf has thickened and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve the pilaf warm, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
